collections.name: UR Fall - Falls and daily activities

preservation.scope: Authenticated original preservation and UI pagination, not retrieval evaluation

resources.note: Snapshot only; not peak memory or combined inference load

limitations: Folder sync is a bounded full scan, not a filesystem watcher or atomic filesystem snapshot.
Retention tests advance only fixture timestamps; no 24-hour wall-clock soak or outage SLA is claimed.
Cleanup requires available services and the small local corpus; backup retention/restore is Phase 7.
Maintenance functions assume database credentials and arbitrary SQL are trusted server privileges.
Fault tests cover the listed application boundaries, not every kernel/provider failure.
No extraction, embeddings, search, generated answers or media playback are delivered by Phase 2.
fingerprint_note: Sorted relative paths and bytes of source, migrations, tests, infrastructure and listed dependency/lifecycle files; excludes credentials and local data.
issues_resolved: Removed an unnecessary reservation FOR UPDATE without granting runtime UPDATE privileges.
Replaced a quadratic RLS join plan with separately authorized bounded batch lookups.
Busy maintenance locks are retried by the test harness without weakening production coordination.
Upload receipt timestamps are not represented as original source modification times.
